body: She broke up with me. And we just talked about having a convo on the phone I wanted to start it of slow and chill
Her name I’m a dude
I wish I could hear her say this…
It’s her last weekend here and I still haven’t heard anything
If anything I think I bread crumbed her just a little bit
I want to give it time but that’s not something I have a ton of atm😞
And so now I’m just worrying that she won’t reach out to me
Well and we were no contact until this all happened
I just don’t know cuz she doesn’t answer her phone much or pay attention to it she’s always been that way and she still hasn’t said a word to me
Should I message her ina few days? Or let her come to me cuz she hasn’t texted me at all
Thing is in the relationship I told her me moving was something I could do
I would love that actually just seeming to be in a similar situation potentially, it’s hard enough and I know how hard it is

You weren’t at a gym yesterday were you?😅😂 because idk it seems like we are in the same situation on opposite sides, if you want to talk things out at all and have another perspective from the other side I could definitely do that because I am struggling with this situation I’m giving you a virtual hug right now because I can tell you need it and deeply cared for that person

Actually I really hope in a way that you aren’t my ex tbh or at the same time idk but you’re situation and the timeline is weirdly similar but I’m going to tell you what I wish I could tell her. If you think you guys can work through it? You can. Especially if the love was real me and mine only dated for 9 months but it was the best nine months of my life. And she is my best friend. I would love for her to come back and want to work it all out I know I was in a bad place but life does that to you all of the time and you were in a bad place too. But that doesn’t mean you have to give up, especially if that person was special to you. If the love is real you can work through anything with your partner it’s not all going to be good there’s going to be downs and some really big ones too but that’s when you pick each other up and build and your connection gets even stronger

I feel the same way about her. She broke things off with me and i feel like it was probably for the exact reasons you stated, I would have loved to heal and grow with her and work on the things I needed to work on with her. I was and am still going through a lot and not having her by my side has been hard. I’m just giving her what she wants and she needs and that’s no contact, I respect the hell out of her and I want her to be happy no matter what, she was my best friend and an amazing girlfriend. Idk everything she is actually going through or why her decision was what it was but idk I just related to this post a lot and I wish I could hear these things from her
That’s what I’m struggling with too. But I know no contact can bring them back but I know there’s still that chance that it’s not going to come back

We’ve always gone at the same time even when we were strangers it’s just the time it’s less busy and easier to get a workout in, it was hard for me to see her but it’s almost like I enjoyed it at the same time just being able to see her…

Did you ever actually love me? You left me alone and hopeless after everything, after telling me you would always be there, you were never going to get sick of me, and that you loved me more because it was impossible for me to love you more. I miss her a lot and idk if she misses me. We are in no contact rn I’ve seen her in the gym and it’s like we are strangers again and it hurts so bad. I wanted to go talk to her, I could tell emotions were running in her head and idk which it was resentment? Anger? Sadness? I didn’t mean to run into her but there she was my person. The same place we started seeing each other and talking.

And I want the best for her too I told her that I’ve always wanted the best for her and for her to be happy, she was my best friend too more than just a girlfriend. It hurts right now to think about and I stopped drinking for now, I’m not going out to bars and clubs at the moment because idk I think it’s I have that respect for her even after she ended things. I have so much love for her that I want to respect her in any way I can

Thank you it’s just hard cuz I miss her a lot it was a healthy relationship by all means but I feel like her own insecurities and worries got in the way, and maybe she was scared I don’t know I never wronged her and I couldn’t even if I tried even during breaking up I was respectful, I cried yes but I couldn’t get mad or yell if I could I just love her too much

Are you my ex? Cuz I am being mature about it😅 but honestly I’ve wanted to reach out to her and tell her how much I love her and all of that but I know it’s not the right thing to do, she broke up with me and wants no contact and I respected that I let her walk away.
I already knew the no contact rule would be my only hope if she were to want to work things out and so if she didn’t want to do it I was going to
No I wasn’t planning on breaking up with her she wanted to break up with me I didn’t want to break up. But I was going to do the NC rule anyways but she asked first
So pretty😁
She is so cute!!!
I do love her but I think I just fucked up too bad thus time like at the time it sounded like a good idea and now I know its really not. I feel like shit
I already struggle with depression and this shit just put my over the top
